description: NaNb₁₃O₃₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.56 Å. There are seven inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.03 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-17°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.22 Å. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-33°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.26 Å. In the fourth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-33°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.28 Å. In the fifth Nb site, Nb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.42 Å. In the sixth Nb site, Nb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.34 Å. In the seventh Nb site, Nb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.39 Å. There are seventeen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Nb atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to four Nb atoms to form distorted ONb₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONb₄ trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Nb₂ tetrahedra. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Nb atoms. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Nb atoms to form ONa₂Nb₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Nb₂ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Nb₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONb₄ trigonal pyramid.
